probe.text_sample: Stereoscope Coffee Close Loading cart... Shop Connect Wholesale Sign in BAG (0) I am, we are, you. Stereoscope Coffee Plant Pursuit of depth and simplicity in coffee, in culture, in life. At the heart of Stereoscope’s philosophy, the concept of the Five Elements is a cycle of living system influenced by nature’s rhythms: Altitude, Soil, Fauna, Climate, Farmer & Roaster. We use this concept to communicate depth and intention that becomes a lens through which we explore the poetry of coffee—rooted in time, shaped by nature, and brought to life through thoughtful design and ritual. about us Coffee as Life: The Flower, the Seed, and the Spirit Learn more Stereoscope Coffee was founded in 2013 by a small team of seasoned baristas and Q-graders, with the clear mission to make highest quality coffee easily accessible, and the vision to serve, improve, and partner with our communities New release new release Ethiopia - Wuri FROM $ 32.20 El Diviso - Ombligon x Gesha Mosto - LTD.
